text_block_list.text:
It's finally time for the Sprinters Stakes.
On our
way to Nakayama Racecourse...

text_block_list.name: Townspeople
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan! Good luck in today's race!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Thanks, everyone. ♪ I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna steal everyone's hearts! ♪
Don't miss it!

text_block_list.name: Townspeople
text_block_list.text:
Wooow!
Sooooo adorable!
Erupting cheers envelop us.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Haha. That was crazy. People were even
calling
out to me at the racecourse. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's like I'm at the center of all the
excitement. I
loooove it! ♪

I do feel like there's more excitement
around her
than before. Or maybe her
fans have just
changed.

text_block_list.text:
Running in this atmosphere is totally
gonna make
me cuter!

As the name suggests, it's a special new
series she
made about summer camp and
her daily training,
a slight departure
from her normally cutesy
channel.

I've been watching every video as soon
as they're
uploaded, but...

text_block_list.text:
Oh, if you watched them right away, you

probably didn't notice. I guess you
totally are my
number one fan! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if you watched them right away, you

probably the best
example.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... One more!

text_block_list.name: On-screen Text
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan is exhausted. Still, she grits
her teeth
and continues to push herself.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I wanna get even faster. I'm gonna keep
on
running so I can keep getting better!

text_block_list.name: On-screen Text
text_block_list.text: Trainer: Why do you try so hard?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I guess... to be the me I wanna be. I want

everyone to see me at my cutest.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Plus, sprints are super fun! I hope that by

watching me, everyone can get into
them.

text_block_list.name: On-screen Text
text_block_list.text:
Just what does Curren Chan have
planned as she
strives to master
cuteness?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The Sprinters Stakes starts at 3:40 p.m.
at
Nakayama Racecourse. Come see how
serious I
can be!

text_block_list.name: On-screen Text
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Racecourse. Curren's home
away from
home.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I think I did a good job on the
editing. Take
a look at the views for the
series.

"Cute Continent" seems to be doing
particularly
well and has a lot of
comments. Among them...

"Her resolve is amazing."
"I didn't care
for her much before, but I might be
a fan
now."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan

The training series was actually pretty
tough for
me... but it sure looks like it
paid off!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Totally seems like it, huh?

text_block_list.text:

that again.

on
UmaTube. I'd call that a great

text_block_list.text:

can't waste
all this attention I've gotten
for myself by losing!

Curren Chan is exuding self-confidence.
If she can
keep this up, the Sprinters
Stakes will be no
problem. Or at least,
that's what I'd like to think.

text_block_list.text: Okay, then. Good luck today, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's do it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Flower's so cute.

looks to

obstacle in today's race.

Did you know they call her the "Bento

one of the top accounts.

Her level of cuteness has already earned

4.35 million followers!

This race isn't gonna be as easy as I
thought.
